An object is beneath the surface of a liquid. One factor that affects the pressure exerted on the
object is the gravitational field strength.
Which other factors affect the pressure due to the liquid?
A
the depth of the liquid and the density of the liquid only
B
the mass of the object and the density of the liquid only
C
the mass of the object and the depth of the liquid only
D
the mass of the object, the depth of the liquid and the density of the liquid

options.label: A
options.text: the depth of the liquid and the density of the liquid only

options.label: B
options.text: the mass of the object and the density of the liquid only

options.label: C
options.text: the mass of the object and the depth of the liquid only

options.label: D
options.text: the mass of the object, the depth of the liquid and the density of the liquid
